description:
Get a single-use link for uploading a race GPX to vertfinder, which analyses it.
Never send a GPX's contents through this conversation or analyse it yourself. If you can run shell commands with internet
access, run the returned curl command with the file's path; it responds with the race id. Otherwise give the person uploadUrl
as a link: it opens an upload page where they choose the file. When they say it's done, call list_races and use the newest race.
The link works once and expires at expiresAt (30 minutes).
name: start_race_upload
